content: Create attractive economic opportunities in rural areas; reduce migration pressure on cities; raise national productivity and quality of life
Strengthen rural food value chains in processing, logistics and trade; support rural SMEs run by women and youth; diversify beyond primary production
Rural digital entrepreneurship and creative industries; remote professional services; attract young professionals back to villages; villages as innovation hubs, not only food producers
Drones, precision irrigation and soil sensors; higher yields and efficiency; mechanisation coupled with access to finance so adoption is inclusive
